Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Corruption
Description:
Earn XP and arousal when you and a nearby player with the plugin both play animations from mods you each picked in Penumbra. Level through corruption tiers, climax into Cummy layers, bond with a regular partner, spend Sins in the shop, and opt into a full pregnancy system. Everything runs locally.
Requires Penumbra, SimpleHeels and a sync service such as Lightless. Cummy, Glamourer, Moodles and Intiface Central are optional. 18+ content.
Punchline: Earn corruption with someone nearby while your animations play.
Changelog:
- Slower pace: a quiet scene climaxes about every 11 minutes, and climaxes, new animations, goals and achievements pay less XP.
- No more AFK check: standing still in a looping animation keeps earning.
- Exclude animations you don't want counted, such as cuddles, from the Acts page or the scene card.
- A partner's climax now layers you through your own Cummy, with no pairing needed. Needs Cummy's plugin API 3.
- Bond at any level. Bonds grow with time together and unlock quirks.
- Sins: earn them from a daily check-in, scenes, levels, goals and achievements, and spend them on 16 items in the new Shop.
- Opt-in pregnancy: a 7-day cycle, conception from a breeder's cum shot at the groin, a 14-day pregnancy with cravings, a growing baby on your profile, and a birth.
- New achievements, trimester visuals and pregnancy Moodles.
